message.content:
CHANGES

Change #1: [Category: Model Architecture / Feature Representation]

- What: Add an explicit "coupon-context interaction residual" block to the DeepFM by introducing a small set of hand-built product/logit-fusion features (e.g., habit_match × distance_bucket, expiry_x_distance × coupon one-hots, coupon-specific accept-rate deviation from global acceptance) and a second low-rank FM component over coupon-conditional subgroups. Concretely: extend FeatureEngineer.transform to emit coupon-conditional centered features (value minus per-coupon mean computed from TRAIN only), and widen the DeepFM's FM embedding to include a "coupon gating" multiplicative Interaction Layer: emb_out = emb ⊙ sigmoid(W_c · coupon_onehot).

- Why: Coupon acceptance is strongly coupon-type-conditional (Bar coupons accepted at very different rates than Coffee House), and the current model already has the right inductive bias (FM + deep) but lacks an explicit mechanism to modulate feature embeddings by coupon type. Street/trip context (distance, direction, expiration) only matters *relative to the coupon*, which the current additive design captures weakly. This is a Type-A architectural deepening, not a replacement.

Change #2: [Category: Regularization / Training Strategy]

- What: Replace fixed threshold search + 5-fold OOF blend-weight selection with a small multi-seed OOF ensemble (3 seeds × 5 folds) and select (w, t) using the median-of-seeds OOF accuracy rather than a single OOF split. Reduce DeepFM stacking to 1 bag with more epochs (18–22) and slightly stronger dropout on the new gating parameters only.

- Why: Threshold tuning on a single OOF split overfits the threshold (variance ~0.005 accuracy) and inflates the "Final Validation Score." Median-of-seeds blend-weight/threshold selection is a variance-reduction mechanism that aligns local selection with the supervisor's independent evaluation without touching held-out labels. It preserves task semantics and metric exactly.

WHY current solution limited

- Root cause: Model is a strong tabular ensemble, but DeepFM's embeddings do not explicitly condition on coupon type; feature engineering emits coupon one-hots and pairwise products, but there is no multiplicative gating and no coupon-centered normalization. The tree zoo absorbs much of this, capping the DeepFM branch contribution, so blend optimizer leans toward trees and blend accuracy plateaus ~0.757.

- Evidence: OOF deep-alone and tree-alone accuracies are individually close to the blended score (blend w=0.5 would imply symmetry only if both branches contributed complementary signal). Also, coupon cardinality is small (5) and highly predictive; adding 5 coupon-gated embedding channels is a cheap, capacity-controlled intervention. Missing-value counts are modest (70–127), so leakage-safe coupon-mean centering is stable.

HOW these changes address it

- Mechanism: Coupon-conditional centering makes trip-context features zero-mean *within each coupon*, forcing the model to learn within-coupon variance rather than mixture means — exactly the signal needed to separate accepters from non-accepters of the same coupon. The gating layer lets the model selectively amplify or suppress embedding dimensions per coupon, giving FM a per-coupon metric space (the classical "field-aware" FM motivation, which the current code names but does not implement). Median-of-seeds threshold selection reduces selection variance so the reported score better predicts held-out accuracy.

- Expected improvement: DeepFM OOF accuracy +0.5–1.5 pts; blended OOF accuracy +0.3–0.8 pts (likely 0.762–0.766). Reduced threshold-selection variance ~0.3–0.5 pts.

- Synergy: Coupon-centered features make the gating parameters easier to learn (lower noise per gate), and gating makes the centered features more useful because the FM can allocate per-coupon capacity — both improve the same branch that the blend currently under-utilizes, so the blend weight can shift toward a stronger complementary deep signal.

KEEP UNCHANGED

- Random seed: 42 (and derived seed formulas 42+fi*10+b preserved).
- Data split: identical 5-fold StratifiedKFold(shuffle=True, random_state=42) on training rows only; prediction path unchanged (fit-on-train-only, reload in new process, row_id = 0..N-1).
- Label encoding, preprocessing fit-on-train-only rule, target-encoding smoothing (25.0), inner 5-fold TE (seed 42), cat block spec construction, tree zoo composition and hyperparameters, output format (row_id,prediction) and argparse interface, artifact layout under --model, 2-thread / 4096 MB / 600 s budgets.
